title: Where are the most photos taken?
content: A while ago, Google released this heat map image showing the places in the world that are photographed the most, based on the geotagging metadata.Tourist places in Europe get the most traffic, especially art capitals like Paris and Barcelona, coastal regions of Spain, and picturesque regions in the Alps.Google's artificial intelligence systems no longer need geotagging to know where a photo was taken. After analyzing huge databases of more than 93 million images,they can now recognize whereanyphoto was taken.
